metaData.originalTitle: “五类人 AI 替代不了，企业做第二名最稳妥” | 昆仑万维方汉@AIGC2026
metaData.title: "Five Types of People AI Cannot Replace, and Being Second is the Safest Strategy" | Kunlun Wanwei Fang Han @ AIGC 2026
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Fang Han, CEO of Kunlun Wanwei, pointed out at the AIGC Industry Summit that experience is no longer a moat. Jobs that are closed-loop and fault-tolerant are most easily replaced by AI, while five types of people—storytellers, idea creators, definers of beauty, system builders, and paradigm reshapers—cannot be replaced. He also advised most enterprises to aim for second place in AI implementation.
metaData.summary: This article is a compilation of Fang Han's speech at the 2026 China AIGC Industry Summit. Drawing on his complete internet cycle experience, Fang Han offered sharp insights on employment, corporate strategy, and technology trends in the AI era. Key points include: Token consumption is becoming the electricity metric of the AI era, with a gap of several orders of magnitude between average and power users; experience is no longer a moat, and closed-loop, fault-tolerant jobs (e.g., artists, programmers, middle management) are most vulnerable to AI replacement, while high-judgment, non-fault-tolerant roles (e.g., surgery, on-site construction) remain safe; with AI's intervention, personal career ladders are compressed, causing middle-tier employees to polarize rapidly into novices and experts; five types of people AI cannot replace: storytellers, idea creators, definers of beauty, system builders, and paradigm reshapers. On corporate strategy, he recommended that most industries aim for second place in AI implementation to avoid the exploration costs of being first and the marginalization of being third, but in the IT sector, only first place matters. He also cautioned that claims from companies currently fundraising or listed about AGI's imminent arrival are merely for market valuation.

mainPoints.point: Experience is no longer a moat; closed-loop, fault-tolerant jobs are most easily replaced by AI.
mainPoints.explanation: If a job's skills are closed-loop and fault-tolerant, such as artists, programmers, and middle management, it is highly susceptible to AI replacement. Conversely, high-judgment, non-fault-tolerant roles like surgery and on-site construction are difficult to replace.

mainPoints.point: Token consumption is becoming the electricity metric of the AI era, reflecting AI strength.
mainPoints.explanation: Average users consume millions of Tokens per month, while heavy Agent users can reach tens of billions—a massive gap. Token consumption, like a nation's electricity usage, will become a hard metric for measuring AI capability.

mainPoints.point: AI compresses personal career ladders, accelerating the polarization of middle-tier employees.
mainPoints.explanation: In the past, employees had a clear growth path from novice to executive, but with AI's involvement, intermediate states struggle to survive, leaving only novices and experts. How the growth journey for ordinary people evolves is worth observing.

mainPoints.point: Five types of people AI cannot replace: storytellers, idea creators, definers of beauty, system builders, and paradigm reshapers.
mainPoints.explanation: These five types of people sit at both ends of the workflow, possessing judgment, creativity, and systemic thinking that AI cannot replicate, making them the most scarce talent in the AI era.

mainPoints.point: Most enterprises should aim for second place in AI implementation to avoid the exploration costs of being first.
mainPoints.explanation: The first mover bears extremely high trial costs, while the third mover misses out on industry dividends. However, in the IT sector, only first place matters. AI brings everyone back to the same starting line, presenting a huge opportunity for young people.

keyQuotes: Experience is no longer a moat.
When an industry or skill is closed-loop and fault-tolerant, it is very easily replaced by AI. But if you have judgment and taste, you can still sustain yourself in the long run.
Token has become the 'electricity consumption' of the AI era.
There are five types of people AI can never replace: storytellers, idea creators, definers of beauty, system builders, and paradigm reshapers.
For AI implementation in most industries, aim to be second.
